answer: Arrival-gap admission queue: each new identity's first 40 actions must span 72 hours with nonperiodic gaps, and a tight comet of synchronized arrivals is rejected. Pending identities wait in a vault with independent clocks, so parallel identities cannot share one timing profile. Low-volume accounts in the same meadow pass on shorter gaps. An attacker pays wall-clock dormancy and padded idle traffic per identity, capped near 0.56 actions/hour.
